name: sign_out
desc: Sign out of the terminal

name: help
desc: Show the command reference

name: availability_a
desc: Air availability search

name: availability_1
desc: Air availability search (alternate entry)

name: schedule_display
desc: Flight schedule by city pair across a 7-day window - times/equipment only, no booking classes or seat availability

name: sell_from_avail
desc: Sell a flight from the last availability display

name: sell_connection
desc: Sell a connection: seats, then class+line for each of the two flights

name: long_sell
desc: Direct/long sell without an availability display

name: name_field
desc: Add passenger name(s), optionally with a lap infant or a (CHD) child-fare tag

name: phone
desc: Add a contact phone number

name: general_remark
desc: Add a general remark (agency-internal, not sent to the carrier)

name: received_from
desc: Add the received-from field

name: price_itinerary
desc: Price the itinerary (fare quote), required before ticketing

name: fare_quote_shop
desc: Shop indicative fares by city pair, independent of any itinerary; add /{CLASS} to see that class's fare rules (change fee, refundable, advance purchase) instead

name: ticketing_at_will
desc: Ticketing arrangement: at will (ticket any time before departure)

name: ticketing_at_will_dated
desc: Ticketing arrangement: at will, queued to a date/time

name: ticketing_time_limit
desc: Ticketing time limit - deadline to ticket by

name: fop_cash
desc: Form of payment: cash

name: fop_check
desc: Form of payment: check

name: fop_credit_card
desc: Form of payment: credit card (VI/CA/AX/DC/DS/JC)

name: issue_tickets
desc: Issue ticket(s) for a saved, priced PNR

name: void_tickets
desc: Void previously issued ticket(s) - same-day reversal, no penalty

name: refund_tickets
desc: Refund previously issued ticket(s) - blocked for nonrefundable fares

name: exchange_ticket
desc: Exchange a previously issued ticket after a fare/itinerary change - applies old value, shows ADCOLL/residual, reissues

name: docs
desc: Add APIS passport/document info for a passenger or infant

name: ssr_fqtv
desc: Add a frequent flyer number, optionally tied to a passenger, with an optional loyalty tier

name: osi
desc: Add other service information for a carrier

name: ssr
desc: Add a special service request (meal, wheelchair, etc.)

name: seat_map
desc: Display the seat map for an itinerary segment

name: seat_assign
desc: Assign a seat on a segment, optionally tied to a passenger

name: decode_airport
desc: Decode a 3-letter airport/city code

name: search_airports
desc: Search airports/cities by name

name: pnr_redisplay
desc: Redisplay the current PNR

name: pnr_history
desc: Display the PNR's chronological activity history

name: pnr_retrieve
desc: Retrieve a saved PNR by its record locator

name: divide_pnr
desc: Divide passenger(s) out of the PNR into a new, separately-locatored PNR

name: queue_enqueue
desc: Place the current PNR on a queue

name: queue_next
desc: Retrieve the next PNR from a queue

name: queue_count
desc: Show queue counts for this PCC

name: cancel_itinerary
desc: Cancel the entire itinerary (all segments)

name: cancel_elements
desc: Cancel a numbered element, range, or list

name: ignore
desc: Ignore the PNR (discard unsaved work)

name: end_transact_er
desc: End transaction: save and redisplay the PNR

name: end_transact_et
desc: End transaction: save and clear the work area

name: end_transact_em
desc: Generate the itinerary document

name: end_transact_emi
desc: Generate the invoice document (itinerary + fare/payment)

name: end_transact_emt
desc: Generate the e-ticket notification document
